identity_provenance: Actual serialNumber field returned by /gatedesc.xml matches existing private G6-A mapping; not inferred solely from LAN IP.
server_header: Linux/4.14.275, UPnP/1.0, Portable SDK for UPnP devices/1.6.20
limits: No mapping add/delete/range operations, pinhole writes, connection controls, event subscriptions, malformed-request probes or configuration changes.
Two read-only shell scripts, four description GETs, one unicast M-SEARCH and six SOAP getters. No router file transfer.
No WAN/guest/IPv6 reachability probe or B9 live request.
NAT/Cable/Up reporting includes constants; no proof of operational Internet connectivity or actual line rate.
XML action description, native selector and live result are separate layers.
Mutation correctness, per-caller ownership, low-port behavior, leases/reboot/reset/bank persistence and hardware forwarding remain untested.
AuthorizeControlPoint identification uses matching upstream signature/call shape and native constant-return bodies; not whole-source/binary equivalence.
Selected UPnP NAT chain empty at final read; mapping index0 returned713. No added mapping used as a test.
